fullPassage: Some researchers view spoken languages as incomplete devices for capturing precise differences. They think numbers represent the most neutral language of description. However, when our language of description is changed to numbers, we do not move toward greater accuracy. Numbers are no more appropriate 'pictures of the world' than words, music, or painting. While useful for specific purposes (e.g. census taking, income distribution), they include information of enormous value. For example, the future lives of young students are tied to their scores on national tests. In effect, whether they can continue with their education, where, and at what cost depends importantly on a handful of numbers. These numbers do not account for the quality of schools they have attended, whether they have been tutored, have supportive parents, have test anxiety, and so on. Finally, putting aside the many ways in which statistical results can be manipulated, there are ways in which turning people's lives into numbers is morally insulating. Statistics on crime, homelessness, or the spread of a disease say nothing of people's suffering. We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus allowing us to escape without being disturbed. Statistics are human beings with the tears wiped off. Quantify with caution.

det.analysis: suffer(동사) → suffering(명사): people's 뒤에 명사가 와야 하므로 동명사형으로 변환
det.tip: suffer(겪다) → suffering(고통, 명사) — 동명사의 명사적 활용

questions.passage: Some researchers view spoken languages as incomplete devices for capturing precise differences. They think numbers represent the most neutral language of description. However, when our language of description is changed to numbers, we do not move toward greater accuracy. Numbers are no more appropriate 'pictures of the world' than words, music, or painting. While useful for ____ (e.g. census taking, income distribution), they include information of enormous value. For example, the future lives of young students are tied to their scores on national tests. In effect, whether they can continue with their education, where, and at what cost depends importantly on a handful of numbers. These numbers do not account for the quality of schools they have attended, whether they have been tutored, have supportive parents, have test anxiety, and so on. Finally, putting aside the many ways in which statistical results can be manipulated, there are ways in which turning people's lives into numbers is morally insulating. Statistics on crime, homelessness, or the spread of a disease say nothing of people's suffering. We read the statistics as reports on events at a distance, thus allowing us to escape without being disturbed. Statistics are human beings with the tears wiped off. Quantify with caution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 특정 목적(specific purposes)에 유용하지만, 엄청난 가치의 정보를 포함한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① general communication
❌ ② artistic expression
❌ ③ daily conversation
✅ ④ specific purposes
det.tip: specific purposes(특정 목적) — 숫자가 유용한 맥락(인구조사, 소득분배 등)

det.korean: 사람의 삶을 숫자로 바꾸는 것은 도덕적으로 차단하는(morally insulating) 것이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① scientifically accurate
✅ ② morally insulating
❌ ③ emotionally engaging
❌ ④ practically beneficial
det.tip: morally insulating = 도덕적으로 차단하는 — 통계가 인간적 고통을 느끼지 못하게 한다는 핵심 주장
